snippet.title: Kernel Hearts demo is out NOW!
snippet.description:
Hello everyone!

Akira, Game Director here.

I'm happy to announce that our very first public demo is now available, featuring 4 player multiplayer co-op.

This is our very first game and we've been working on it for the past four years. It would mean a lot to us if you played it.

For those who played the previous playtest, first of all, thank you. We invite you to try out the new changes. We feel it's the best the game has ever been, and we can't wait to see you play it.

We’ll be waiting for you on our Discord (discord.gg/KernelHearts), where you can talk directly with the devs and the community.

As always, thanks a lot for your support, making games is hard but your support makes it a hell of a lot easier.

Hope you enjoy this piece of our soul.
